fixes: Choice: (c) split, with (b) inside each part; not (a). Reason: the S face length is set by its partners (3,625 S pins aligned under the neighbours), so shrinking the outline (a) breaks pin alignment, and a single 881-um spine (b alone) still gives ~300 ps. Do: split ectlk into 2 cores of ~440 um (W core = SRAMs + H logic + W face regs + W half of S; E core = E face regs + E half of S), each with its own clock pin at its S-face centre fed from the die/parent tap (use the existing ck[1]/ck[2]; un-tie them in RTL, no tie-offs). Inside each, a fishbone spine along the S face with taps every ~100 um, so max tap->flop < ~120 um and insertion lands ~250-300 ps. rst_n: one relay per core at equal depth (decision 2). Also, per your COORD note: the core SDC vclk must carry the core-latency contract (vclk = measured I, decision 5e). Placement + CTS pictures come back here before route.
